offering_description.value: Operates expedition cruise ships and small vessels that take travelers to remote polar, wildlife and cultural destinations, in partnership with National Geographic. Also sells land-based adventure and nature tours through acquired travel companies. Sells to leisure travelers directly and through travel agents.

primary_services.value: expedition cruises; guided land-based adventure tours; river cruises; onboard travel experiences and excursions

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers, often older affluent adventure and nature travelers

end_markets.value: leisure travel; expedition cruising; adventure and eco-tourism

revenue_model.value: service fees: passenger fares for expedition cruises and land tours, including lodging, meals and excursions; other: onboard sales and optional extras such as pre/post trip packages

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates expedition ships, selling voyages to leisure travelers; service provider: organizes guided land tours using purchased lodging and local operators

geography_served.value: global: Antarctica, Arctic, Galápagos, Alaska, Europe, Central America and other remote destinations, customers mainly from the US

specialization.value: related lines: expedition cruises and land-based adventure tours for travelers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct bookings via website, call centers and repeat guests; agents / brokers: travel advisors and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime safety, environmental and polar rules (IMO Polar Code, IAATO, Coast Guard), port and passenger regulations
